title: Mini paper (our own questions) and success criteria
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y11 lesson 57 (Pupil PDF worksheet: mini paper (our own questions) and success criteria)
intro: Lesson 57: Final run-through: mini paper and exam-day plan. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

checklist: Describe: accurate points, no explanation needed
Explain: point, develop, evidence (Qur'an or hadith from your lessons)
12-mark: both sides developed with evidence, then a justified conclusion

panels.title: The mini paper
points: One Section A and one Section B question
70 minutes in two parts: class and home

keywords.def: a full practice from start to finish
marking your own work with the success criteria
doing your best and relying on Allah

questions.a: For example: learn 9:128-129 meaning; practise one 12-mark daily; review 2.6 angels

questions.q: Mini paper in the portal response box: Section A question (35 minutes) in the lesson; Section B question (35 minutes) at home under time. Self-mark the Section A answer with the success criteria before the end of the lesson.
questions.a: Answers per the mark scheme style criteria: accurate describe, developed explain, balanced 12-mark with passage and judgement

questions.q: Extend: green-pen one improvement into your 12-mark answer.
The night before the exam is best spent ...
questions.a: A) Light review, salah and sleep. Rest helps memory; tawakkul after effort.
